description: Setup Total Planned uses actual total costs before the current month and planned total costs from the current month through the end of the project.
implementation: Reuse the existing Cash Flow setup expenses calculation, whose monthly cutoff is EOMONTH(TODAY(), -1) + 1. Existing named functions are retained; no direct-range replacement or named-function definition edits.
appsScript: No source changes or clasp synchronization required.
